overview.description: The iShares Large Cap Core Active ETF (BLCR) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell 1000 index. The fund is an actively managed fund of attractively valued large-cap equity securities selected through fundamental and quantitative analysis. It primarily holds US companies but may invest in foreign securities up to 25%. BLCR was launched on Oct 24, 2023 and is issued by BlackRock.
